Volume optimization.Recommendation: Cautious volume loading with saline or Ringer's lactate, ~500 mL over 15–30 min
Volume optimization.Considerations: Consider in patients with normal/low central venous pressure (for example, concomitant hypovolaemia)
Volume optimization.Caveats: Volume loading can over-distend the RV, worsen ventricular interdependence, and reduce cardiac output

Norepinephrine.Properties_and_use: Increases RV inotropy and systemic blood pressure, promotes positive ventricular interactions, and restores coronary perfusion gradient
Norepinephrine.Caveats: Excessive vasoconstriction may worsen tissue perfusion

Dobutamine.Properties_and_use: Increases RV inotropy and lowers filling pressures
Dobutamine.Caveats: May aggravate arterial hypotension if used alone without a vasopressor; may trigger or aggravate arrhythmias

VA-ECMO/extracorporeal life support.Use: Rapid short-term support combined with an oxygenator
VA-ECMO/extracorporeal life support.Caveats: Complications with use over longer periods (>5–10 days) including bleeding and infections; no clinical benefit unless combined with surgical embolectomy; requires an experienced team
